conceptZh: 玩具貓沿著「下」的直筆滑下，掉進小拖鞋；拖鞋突然鼓成大貓掌，搖搖擺擺走開。
object: A solid blue 下, a tiny wind-up toy cat, and a stretchy toy slipper.
morph: The glyph remains correctly formed and stationary. Its vertical stroke guides the cat's downward slide; the slipper briefly expands into an enormous padded paw.
creativeAngle: 把直筆變成玩具貓的下滑路線，用小拖鞋突然鼓成巨大貓掌的尺寸反差製造笑點，全程保留正確字形。
promptEn: Create an 8-second stylized 3D toy animation with a locked frontal camera, soft lighting, and a pale peach background. Center one correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph 下 in saturated solid cobalt blue, occupying about 70% of frame height with comfortable margins. Give it a long horizontal top stroke, a straight vertical descending from that bar, and a separate short diagonal dot on the right below the bar. Keep every stroke stationary, fully readable, and uncropped throughout. A tiny wind-up toy cat with visible plastic joints clings beside the vertical stroke; a little coral toy slipper waits beneath its lower endpoint without touching the glyph. From 0.0–1.3 seconds, the cat looks down at the slipper, confidently stretches one paw toward it, and pauses. From 1.3–2.7 seconds, it slides straight down alongside the vertical stroke, its paws spinning harmlessly. At 2.7 seconds it plops into the tiny slipper: the slipper instantly puffs into an absurdly oversized padded cat paw, with only the cat's curled toy tail poking out. From 3.0–4.5 seconds, the giant slipper takes two comically ponderous waddling steps sideways and exits completely. Keep this action below the strokes. From 4.5–8.0 seconds, hold the clean, motionless glyph alone. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly “下、下、下面”. Place the first 下 around 0.4 seconds, the second around 1.6 seconds, and 下面 around 5.3 seconds while the finished glyph is isolated and clearly visible. Use a soft sliding sound, a gentle rubber puff, and two quiet padded footsteps beneath the voice; no music. The only on-screen text is the single glyph 下; the vocabulary remains audio only. Keep the composition free of subtitles, additional lettering, watermarks, clutter, and flashing effects.

conceptZh: 長短手機器人想摸下面的地板，短手怎樣都摸不到，竟用長手把自己壓成矮盒子，終於成功。
object: An original boxy toy robot assembled from mismatched plastic parts, with one conspicuously long arm and one tiny arm.
morph: The glyph remains correctly formed and stationary. Beside it, the robot presses its telescoping body downward into a squat stack of boxes.
creativeAngle: 改用長短手造成的身體尺寸笑點：不是沿筆畫滑落，而是長手把自己壓矮，讓短手終於碰到下面。字形全程固定，笑點不干擾辨字。
promptEn:
Create an 8-second stylized 3D animation with a locked frontal camera, warm soft lighting, and a light buttery-yellow background and floor. Center the single Traditional Chinese glyph 下 in saturated solid cobalt blue, approximately 70% of frame height, fully uncropped with generous margins. Use a correctly formed printed glyph: a long horizontal top stroke, a straight vertical descending from that horizontal, and a distinct short diagonal dot to the right of the vertical below the top stroke. Keep its silhouette crisp and every stroke stationary throughout.

In the open space to the lower right, clearly separated from the glyph, introduce an original, proudly resourceful boxy toy robot made from mismatched coral, turquoise, and mustard plastic parts. Its segmented left arm is conspicuously long; its right arm is comically tiny. Give it an expressive face made from simple inset shapes and a torso built from visibly nesting rectangular sections. Use only stylized animated objects.

At 0.0–0.9 seconds, the robot spots the floor directly beneath its tiny hand and confidently reaches downward. At 0.9–1.8 seconds, it bends its knees and stretches that tiny arm with great determination, but the fingertips still hang just above the floor. It pauses and looks from its tiny hand to its enormous other arm. At 1.8–3.2 seconds, instead of touching the floor with the long hand, it plants that hand on its own head and pushes straight DOWN. Its torso sections telescope into one another and its knees fold outward until the formerly tall robot becomes an absurdly squat little box. Its tiny fingertips finally tap the floor with a soft tick. Hold a brief delighted eye-widening reaction: success! At 3.2–4.6 seconds, still compressed into a box, it gives a tiny triumphant wave and waddles completely off the right edge on its folded feet. Keep all action outside the glyph silhouette, with the downward compression clearly visible beside the vertical stroke. From 4.6–8.0 seconds, hold the centered glyph alone, completely motionless and unobstructed.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly “下、下、下面”. Speak the first 下 around 0.4 seconds, the second around 2.1 seconds as the robot presses itself downward, and 下面 around 5.3 seconds during the clean final hold. Finish after that word. Add only quiet plastic sliding sounds, the gentle fingertip tick, and soft waddling footsteps beneath the voice; no music. The vocabulary is audio only. The single glyph 下 is the only on-screen text; keep the image free of subtitles, logos, watermarks, clutter, and flashing effects.
